_doc: Which PAR SBI class descriptions (SBI_KLASS2, exact text) an OSM category points to. A tie-breaker among the 30 m, section-compatible candidates of crosswalk.json: where exactly one candidate has a listed class, it is proposed. Proposed by claude-opus-5-5 (S06-095) as rules for deterministic application. Covers the most frequent OSM categories only.
